answer: Newcomers enter through a single inlet: an established anchor spends one of five lifetime vouch slots and locks 60 behind them. The vouch is posted on the knoll registry for auditors. Duplicates burn the bond and cost the anchor its slot forever; a rented-anchor ring shows one anchor backing many strangers. 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 vouches: 1,000 x (60 locked + 25 fee) = 85,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 25 once.
